identity.summary: An attacker uses route.exe to list routing table entries, which is uncommon behavior for a standard user session. Cortex detects this through process execution and network telemetry. The behavioral AB
identity.description: An attacker uses route.exe to list routing table entries, which is uncommon behavior for a standard user session. Cortex detects this through process execution and network telemetry. The behavioral ABIOC flags this activity as a deviation from normal routing table access patterns.

payload.code:
C:\Windows\System32\route.exe print
C:\Windows\System32\route.exe add 192.0.2.0 mask 255.255.255.0 10.0.0.1
C:\Windows\System32\route.exe delete 192.0.2.0

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of route.exe with print argument

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon routing table listing via route.exe
biocs.description: Detection of route.exe being executed with print argument in an unusual context
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'route.exe'
| filter action_file_path = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\route.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'cmd.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'powershell.exe'

abiocs.name: Uncommon routing table listing behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of route.exe being used in an unexpected way, deviating from typical user behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'route.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'cmd.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'

xql_queries.name: Route.exe process start detection

| filter action_process_image_name = 'route.exe'
